question: Why did Tesla's net income fall in 2024?
summary: Tesla's net income fell in FY2024: $15.00B -> $7.09B (-52.7%). The evidence is consistent with one driver: income tax expense rose. Only one independent driver was supported, so treat this as a partial explanation.

H6: Revenue fell in the same direction as profit

reference: Net income fell 53% mainly because 2023 included a one-time $5.9B non-cash tax benefit from releasing a valuation allowance; operating income also fell on lower vehicle prices (Tesla 2024 10-K).
